description: Accommodations for students with specific learning disabilities including dyslexia, dysgraphia, dyscalculia, and auditory processing disorders
specific_accommodations: 50-100% additional time on exams depending on assessment type
Use of text-to-speech and speech-to-text software
Alternative exam formats (oral exams, typed vs handwritten)
Testing in a separate, quiet location
Access to lecture recordings and slides in advance
Note-taking services or permission to record lectures
Use of spell-checker and grammar-checker on exams
Calculator permitted for math courses (including non-calculator sections)
Reduced reading load or alternative reading format
notes: Strongly encourage tutoring and academic skill development workshops. Connect with writing center for additional support.
